name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Client Account Manager
summary: Client Account Manager with 15+ years as the primary point of contact for B2B SaaS clients, guiding technical setup, configuration, and troubleshooting while driving retention and account growth. Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at Wix (120% of sales targets, 110% of implementation targets); managed 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye at roughly 94% retention. Comfortable translating complex software workflows into clear guidance for non-technical stakeholders, and pairing day-to-day account management with the KPI tracking, QBRs, and strategic account planning that keep clients renewing and growing.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B clients on complex SaaS platforms, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals and drive them toward measurable outcomes.
Configure and troubleshoot CRM and automation systems (GoHighLevel, HubSpot) as clients' primary technical point of contact, resolving setup issues and guiding platform adoption.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand account scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, tracking client-level KPIs across platform adoption and account health.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise system configurations and workflows, bridging business intent and technical execution.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping engagement records auditable across concurrent accounts.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and client stakeholders.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and quarterly business reviews.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.
Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration of reputation-management and marketing-automation tools as their primary point of contact.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value and adopt new features.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering onboarding, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Carried a combined sales and implementation load in year two, after the role expanded from a primarily sales focus in year one.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in workflow configuration and pipeline automation.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
